CommonCodeBlockLanguagesTips: Selected languages will be pinned at the top, separated by commas.
MaximumCodeBlockHeightTips: Applies to code blocks without their own height. Blocks already set in the block menu are unchanged.
AdjustCodeBlockHeightTips: Dragging writes the official code block height. If a maximum height is set, the drag range will not exceed it.
DisplayCollapseExpandCodeBlockButton: Display Collapse/Expand Button for Code Block
KeywordFilterNotebooksMatchSubdocuments: Keyword Filter for Notebooks - Match Subdocuments
MiddleClickToggleDocTree: Middle-click to expand/collapse notebooks or documents
MiddleClickResizeImageWidthDesc: Units are required. Example: 200px, px: fixed width; 25%, %: viewport percentage.
ZoomWidthLoadedImagesCurrentDocument: Zoom the width of loaded images in the current document
ShowTopBatchZoomBtn: Show a batch image zoom button at the top
MiddleClickToggleProtyleTitleOrList: Ctrl + Middle-click to zoom lists in the editor
MiddleClickToggleProtyleTitleOrListDesc: Only modifies the current style temporarily; it will revert after a refresh.
SettingBackupDesc: Keymap, appearance, and editor settings live in the workspace conf folder and do not sync with notes. Backups are stored in plugin data so they can sync with the workspace and be restored on another device.
SettingBackupEmpty: No backups yet. Use the button above to save this device's settings.
SettingBackupCreateSuccess: Current settings have been backed up
SettingBackupDeleteConfirm: Delete this backup? This cannot be undone.
SettingBackupRestoreIntro: The following backup will overwrite matching local settings on this device:
SettingBackupDeviceMismatch: This backup came from a different kind of device. Layout usually cannot be shared; restore keymap and other general settings only.
SettingBackupSelectSection: Select at least one setting to restore
SettingBackupReloadConfirm: Settings have been written. Reload the UI for them to take full effect?
SettingBackupNotFound: This backup could not be found
SettingBackupCompatUnknownVersion: The backup or current version could not be read. Confirm before restoring.
SettingBackupCompatMajorMismatch: This backup is from a different SiYuan major version. Settings may not match.
SettingBackupCompatNewer: This backup is from a newer SiYuan. The current version may not understand some settings.
SettingBackupCompatNewerPatch: This backup is from a slightly newer patch. It should work, but confirm first.
SettingBackupCompatOlder: This backup is from an older SiYuan. Newer settings on this device will be kept.
